channel.title: PostgreSQL — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by PostgreSQL (postgresql).

item.title: CVE-2026-116252 · 7.1 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: Materialized view refresh redirects its connection through a crafted database name
item.description: pgAdmin 4's materialized view refresh passed the target database's name to psql's --dbname argument unchanged. libpq treats a --dbname value containing "=" (or a postgresql:// URI) as a full connection string, whose keywords override the host, port a…

item.title: CVE-2026-116251 · 4.2 MEDIUM — pgAdmin 4: A user's other sessions survive a change of their password
item.description: pgAdmin 4 did not invalidate a user's existing sessions when their password changed, either through the user's own change password dialog or through an administrator resetting it in User Management. A session established before the change, for exampl…

item.title: CVE-2026-116250 · 7.3 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: Files opened in a storage directory follow a symbolic link, hard link or FIFO planted after the containment check
item.description: In server mode pgAdmin 4 validates a path a user gives for a file in their storage directory with check_access_permission() and then opened it by name. Several places opened it with a plain open() or handed the path to a utility that opened it later:…

item.title: CVE-2026-116249 · 8.4 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: Connection file paths and parameter keys escape the user's storage directory
item.description: In server mode pgAdmin 4 resolves a server's password file, SSL certificate, key, CRL and SSH tunnel identity file relative to the user's storage directory, but get_complete_file_path() only stripped leading slashes before joining the two. A path suc…

item.title: CVE-2026-116248 · 6.8 MEDIUM — pgAdmin 4: Non-administrators can share a server with every user
item.description: In pgAdmin 4 server mode only administrators are meant to share a server with all users; the server dialog shows the Shared switch only to them. The create and update endpoints of the server API, however, stored the "shared" flag and shared username…

item.title: CVE-2026-116247 · 8.2 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: libpq uses the pgAdmin service account's own password file and client certificate
item.description: When a server in pgAdmin 4 had no password file, client certificate or client key configured, or the configured one could not be found, pgAdmin left the parameter out of the connection and libpq fell back to the defaults of the operating-system accou…

item.title: CVE-2026-116246 · 7 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: Server passwords are left in pgAdmin's process environment
item.description: To pass a server's password to psql and to the utilities pgAdmin 4 runs as background processes, the server manager wrote it into pgAdmin's own process environment: as PGPASSWORD for the PSQL tool, and under a per-process variable for a utility. Noth…

item.title: CVE-2026-116245 · 8.2 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: Connection services are not restricted in server mode
item.description: libpq looks a connection service up in the service file of the operating-system account running pgAdmin 4, and an entry there can hold a password or name a password file or client certificate. In server mode any user could set a server's Service, or…

item.title: CVE-2026-116244 · 8.2 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: libpq uses the pgAdmin service account's Kerberos credentials
item.description: When a pgAdmin 4 connection was not meant to use a Kerberos user's delegated credentials, pgAdmin removed KRB5CCNAME from its environment, so the Kerberos library fell back to the default credential cache, or a client keytab, of the operating-system…

item.title: CVE-2026-116243 · 7.7 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: Utility binary path can point at a shared storage directory
item.description: pgAdmin 4 runs pg_dump, pg_restore, pg_dumpall and psql from the binary path a user sets in their preferences. In server mode the binary path was refused only when it lay under the per-user storage directory (STORAGE_DIR), not under a SHARED_STORAGE…

item.title: CVE-2026-116242 · 8.2 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: SSH tunnels use the pgAdmin service account's own SSH identity
item.description: pgAdmin 4 opens SSH tunnels with the sshtunnel library but gave it neither host_pkey_directories nor ssh_config_file, so it always loaded the unencrypted private keys in ~/.ssh of the operating-system account running pgAdmin, read that account's ~/.s…

item.title: CVE-2026-116241 · 9.9 CRITICAL — pgAdmin 4: Import/Export Data query export runs a command through a backslash in a double-quoted identifier
item.description: pgAdmin 4's Import/Export Data tool wraps a user's query export in a psql \copy (...) TO command and checks that the query's parentheses are balanced so that nothing can escape the wrapper. The check rejected a backslash inside a single-quoted string…

item.title: CVE-2026-116240 · 7.1 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: File Manager and storage-path tools act on a different path from the one checked
item.description: In server mode pgAdmin 4 validates a path into the user's storage directory with check_access_permission(), which builds the absolute path with get_abs_path(). Several callers then acted on a path they built differently, so the path checked and the p…

item.title: CVE-2026-116239 · 8.9 HIGH — pgAdmin 4: An LDAP or Kerberos login is logged in to another account with the same username
item.description: In server mode pgAdmin 4 keeps an account per authentication source, so the same username can exist as, for example, an internal account and an LDAP account. After LDAP or Kerberos authenticated a user, pgAdmin chose the account to log in by username…

item.title: CVE-2026-116238 · 9.2 CRITICAL 🌩️ — pgAdmin 4: The failed login limit can be bypassed, and Flask-Security's own views skip pgAdmin's login and password checks
item.description: In server mode pgAdmin 4 locks an internal account after MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS failed logins (3 by default). The limit could be bypassed, giving an unauthenticated attacker an unlimited number of password guesses against any internal account, including…

item.title: CVE-2026-110183 · 4.3 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: statistics can expose some of the original data after statistic masking
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer contains a vulnerability related to static masking and statistics persistence. Statistics pertaining to the original data remain visible in pg_stats until an ANALYZE operation is performed on the table, either manually or by aut…

item.title: CVE-2026-110182 · 4.3 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: anon.partial() and anon.partial_email() can reveal the whole data
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer contains a vulnerability related to the anon.partial() and anon.partial_email() functions. These function can reveal the while data if the data is small enough. The issue is fixed in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later version…

item.title: CVE-2026-110181 · 6.5 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Function declared with SQL-standard syntax leak anonymized data
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer contains a vulnerability related to anonymization functions defined using SQL-standard function bodies. PostgreSQL analyses such functions at declaration time, while Anonymizer only attempts to check them at execution time. This…

item.title: CVE-2026-105620 · 6.5 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: A masked role reads the authentic data of masked tables through a masking rule with a sub-query
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer doesn't mask data returned by a sub-query in a rule. The problem is resolved in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later versions.

item.title: CVE-2026-105619 · 4.8 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Masking rules of the tables are not applied through security_invoker views
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer doesn't mask data accessed thru a security_invoker view. The problem is resolved in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later versions.

item.title: CVE-2026-105618 · 5.7 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Masked partitions and child tables are not masked when they are queried through their parent
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer's documentation recommends applying rules on partitions and inheritance tables. Direct access to the paritions / inheritance tables is masked but not thru the parent table. The problem is resolved in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0…

item.title: CVE-2026-105617 · 5.7 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Cached plans bypass transparent dynamic masking after a role change or a new masking rule
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer doesn't invalidate plans prepared after a rule was added or a role changed. Users using such plans can still see the unmasked data until the end of the session. The problem is resolved in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later ve…

item.title: CVE-2026-105616 · 5.7 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: The secret salt and shift of anon are readable by any role in pg_roles or pg_db_role_setting
item.description: PostgreSQL restricts acces to the salt and shift via the `SHOW` command for users not member of `pg_read_all_settings`. But they are visible in `pg_db_role_setting` or `pg_roles` if they were set on the database, user or both. PostgreSQL Anonymizer's…

item.title: CVE-2026-105615 · 3.5 LOW — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Masked roles can read the statistics of masked columns in pg_stats
item.description: PostgreSQL's optimized statistics on a table are visible as long as you have SELECT privilege on said table. A masked role can therefore read a limited subset of the data through the statistics view's histograms and mcvs. The vulnerability is resolve…

item.title: CVE-2026-105614 · 4.7 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Unbounded image-decode memory allocation (DoS) in anon.image_blur()
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer's `anon.image_blur()` function doesn't check the declared dimension of the provided image, allowing an attacker to provide a small image with enormous declared dimensions. This vulnerability can be exploited to exhaust the memor…

item.title: CVE-2026-105613 · 4.7 MEDIUM — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Unbounded memory allocation (DoS) in range-based dummy functions
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer's range-based dummy functions dont constraint the range size. This vulnerability can be exploited to exhaust the memory of a backend and OOM-kill it (when ovecommit is on), which results in a cluster-wide crash recovery. The pro…

item.title: CVE-2026-105612 · 3.5 LOW — PostgreSQL Anonymizer: Data-modifying CTEs bypass the read-only restriction of masked roles
item.description: PostgreSQL Anonymizer contains a vulnerability that data-modifying CTEs to bypass the read-only restriction of masked roles. The problem is resolved in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later versions

item.description: Integer wraparound in psqlODBC SQLBindParameter allows an application, or an attacker who controls how many parameters the application binds on one statement, to corrupt heap memory. psqlODBC stores the binding count in a signed 16-bit field. Binding…

item.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, versions 42.7.4 through 42.7.13 pads a value that is shorter than its declared length with bytes left in its send buffer instead of zeros, and the server stores those bytes as part of the value. The bytes are messa…

item.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, versions 42.7.11 through 42.7.13 enforce no restriction when the requireAuth connection property excludes all six authentication methods the driver knows, for example requireAuth=!password,!md5,!gss,!sspi,!scram-sh…

item.title: CVE-2026-103484 · 8.8 HIGH — pgvector buffer overflow in IVFFlat index build
item.description: IVFFlat index build in pgvector before 0.8.7 allows a database user to write data out-of-bounds, which can lead to arbitrary code execution.
